blockers.description: Strict archived prefix comparison rejects the new support.native_contact_boundary key at step1 before the requested diagnostic. archived_projection only removes kind and owner.transfer.
blockers.requiredResolution: Explicitly validate/archive fresh telemetry but omit exactly this new optional field for old-prefix comparison, preserve every historical field and byte-sensitive numeric comparison. Test schema acceptance and rejection of old-field/clock drift without physics.
blockers.resolution: archived_projection removes exactly support.native_contact_boundary; compare_live_prefix requires deserializable schema1 telemetry, matching frame/support/native clocks and25 ordered segment pairs. Existing fields still use exact_json; pure negative cases added; execution remains central.

requiredEvidence: Every completed predicted boundary carries support.native_contact_boundary with matching native_substep, all25 segment pairs, handles and generations.
At refusal, persist a fresh native endpoint even if owner.lastObserved still names the previous accepted boundary; endpoint support is authoritative.
Preserve raw manifold and active solver-cluster collection, all geometric points, selected indices, impulses, current anchors, separation and exclusion reasons.
Archive first and preceding boundary around any change; do not infer stable material identity from indices, contact_id or feature_id alone.
Reconcile admitted selected-contact loads with support.segments.contacts using the same normal/impulse/distance/native-dt classifier.
Abort with missing-diagnostic outcome if telemetry or endpoint is unavailable; no substitute run or silent success.

distinguishableOutcomes.evidence: Same current geometric point remains selected, impulse zero, zero_impulse exclusion; shows no current selected normal impulse at that boundary.
Raw geometric point present, selected_contact_indices empty, unselected_manifold_point reason; cached impulse is not current load.
Selected point present with upward_normal_below_minimum and/or live_separation_exceeded, exact measurements retained.
Raw point disappears or changes local position/features while pair/subshape and other geometric points persist; correspondence requires geometric comparison, not index equality.
pair_present false or absent current solver manifold; support loss local to this representation, with segment integrated/current load recorded separately.

limitations: No new observations have been executed; recurrence at78 is not promised.
No internal recycle_state/full-narrowphase-update flag or intermediate selection history is exposed. New-contact bit alone does not prove a fresh manifold update.
Current selected impulse divided by native dt is a boundary metric, not enclosing-step average when CCD has multiple intervals; original CCD impulse journal remains separate.
Observed manifold replacement alone does not prove mechanically equivalent loaded support, wholefoot separation, contact moment feasibility or full standing continuation.
If native observation itself errors before endpoint serialization, complete contact telemetry may be unavailable; this is a failed diagnostic and must close the run.

Collider poses are propagated at normal completed steps, but raw manifold geometry was not recomputed after final integration; transformed raw points alone cannot prove current closest/contact geometry.

poseFreshness.sourceFinding: Vendored advance_to_final_positions updates active body pose and attached collider pose before the native callback. Normal callback boundary is after world.step_with_events returns.
poseFreshness.rawGeometryLimitation: Final CCD interval refreshes broad phase only; no final narrow-phase rerun. Raw tracked local points/features/stored distance may come from the prior or recycled narrow phase. Current-world raw coordinates only transform those cached geometric points through current poses, with stored manifold normal.
causalEvidencePriority: current selected anchors resolved through body poses
poseFreshness.postRunCheck: Compare reported collider pose with current body pose composed with known collider attachment, and inspect selected anchor/segment-local reconstruction; no new FK or collision query.

requires: observation and boundary clocks equal endpoint clock
localDiagnostic sample clock equals endpoint clock

staleSampleExample.outcome: endpoint completeness refused; current support and boundary78 remain archived, previous localDiagnostic77 is not misrepresented as current

endpointCompletenessGuard.whenSampleAbsent: diagnostic-endpoint-incomplete explicitly archives current support and endpointRefusal
endpointCompletenessGuard.secondaryRecord: diagnostic-endpoint-refused carries endpointRefusal and originalForecastOutcome; returned error carries both
endpointCompletenessGuard.reviewMethod: source inspection only; no Rust mutation, test, worker, physics or FK execution
